## ShopMate Industry ERP v4.3.2

- Dual Top & Bottom Table Scrollbars: Full-width native horizontal scrollbars at both the top and bottom of all wide tables across the entire ERP.
- Smooth Drag Synchronization: Native drag ownership lock preventing cancellation or stutter during horizontal table navigation.
- Factory vs Commercial Procurement Separation: General trading items strictly segregated from factory raw/packing materials with dedicated 'Raw Material Supplier' party flags.
- Commercial Store Transfer Modal Alignment: Harmonized combo box widths, numeric quantity inputs, asset values, and voucher posting controls.
- Smart Product Name Builder: Dynamic name generator integrated into production catalog material enrollment.
- Industrial Production & Manufacturing Architecture: Real-time double-entry ledger integration and autonomous database self-healing.
